title: Epic Seven
description:
● PLAY THE ANIMATION — An anime RPG enjoyed by 20 million players worldwide!Diche, the Goddess of Life, shared her power to bring the Heir of the Covenant and the Guardians into this world.

"Heir, protect the world." — We invite you to the Seventh World, an epic saga crafted by master storytellers.

Epic Seven is a Hero collection RPG that blends hand-drawn, full-frame 2D animation with deep, strategic turn-based combat. Collect and build hundreds of unique Heroes, and experience battles that play like a cinematic anime.

● Cinematic Anime BattlesEpic Seven's signature full-frame 2D animation! The moment a Hero casts their Ultimate, dazzling hand-drawn cutscenes come to life frame by frame. Experience breathtaking animations with every skill you unleash.

● An Expansive and Beautiful StoryAn epic saga crafted by master storytellers. From the main storyline to the hidden backstories of your Heroes, countless tales breathe life into the Seventh World. Immerse yourself in this rich and expansive world.

● Strategic Turn-Based CombatVictory is earned through strategy, not brute force. Master skill timing, balance Effectiveness and Effect Resistance, and outwit your opponents in the strategic Ban Pick phase. Every decision can determine the outcome of battle.

● World Arena — Real-Time PvPFace off against players from around the world in intense real-time strategic battles. The battle begins with the Ban Pick phase, where reading your opponent's team composition and making the right draft decisions are the keys to victory.
description_short: PLAY THE ANIMATION! A playable anime in your hands, Epic Seven. A turn-based Hero collection RPG alive with stunning 2D visuals. Collect unique Heroes in the Seventh World and plan your path to victory through elemental effects and skill combinations. Challenge Heirs worldwide in World Arena PvP.
